verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own marketing says merchants can share unique checkout links and sell anywhere, build a store without coding, and accept payments from 135+ countries with zero setup. Together these cover the core of a no-code shareable payment link with immediate selling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the dashboard workflow for creating a checkout link, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**.
accept payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup
